purpose: Environment for the isolated staging preview gateway that runs plan sparring. Applied as one task-definition revision of the staging gateway, in a DEDICATED ECS service and target group. Never applied to vitana-gateway or to any production target group.
enforcement: GATEWAY_RUNTIME_PROFILE=preview-sparring makes the process start the HTTP API only (services/gateway/src/runtime/runtime-profile.ts, guard in index.ts). The flags below are defence in depth for workers that might be enabled by an external switch.
must_not_set: any production Aurora writer endpoint or production secret ARN
EVENTBRIDGE schedule targets pointing at this service

database.allowed: the staging Aurora cluster vitana-aurora-staging, only after its schema, authenticator and PostgREST dependency pass acceptance
database.status: NOT READY: migration acceptance has not been established (see the gateway preview PR)

service.target_group: a NEW target group for this service; not vitana-tg-gateway-prod
service.routing: preview-aws-gateway.vitanaland.com must route to this target group only, through an isolated listener rule or ingress; production listener rules are not modified by this change
